scope: Original template binding, current-value isolation, version/source boundaries and complete former-variable audit

checks.name: PC boot uses the unchanged original PLAYER template and the current visible name without identity setup
Incomplete boot text, long or broken names, appended events, placeholder injection and wrong layouts remain raw
PC ownership, player house, party actions and honorifics reuse only their original source-scoped tokens
Rival helping their father uses the unchanged original localized help-and-affection unit and only the current rival name
Current HP recipient and amount are rebound on every call, including observed digit width
The same RSC token label has different reviewed roles for PC, move use, switch intent and normal experience
Moves and ordinary stat changes fill original buffers with source-backed complete terms, not generated phrases
Normal experience binds actor, verified empty modifier and current displayed amount across the Japanese/English buffer difference
Switch intent cannot publish the following question and the question cannot reuse an earlier actor or species
Trainer class boundaries, distinct actors and ability call-site constraints are preserved
Fainting, status, recall, catching and item use keep literal original templates and current actor labels
Reviewed same-event wording chooses an unchanged original variant; unreviewed version conflicts still remain raw
Original quote, token mapping, component witnesses and Japanese-source tampering are rejected or fail closed
All 101 former variable fallback cases have explicit outcomes and no generic variable blocker remains
